title: The measuring Chrome's font cache fetches Google's dynamic subset font addresses (/l/font?kit=...) with their query, so those faces load instead of failing FONT-1, PREV-1 and PREVIEW-PARITY at random
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/test/cdp-font-host.test.mjs (no network: the fetch is a double)
S2: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts.
expect: S1 exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.

fontFetchUrl returns a fonts.gstatic.com/l/font?kit=...&skey=... address unchanged byte for byte, keeps every fetch on fonts.gstatic.com with path /l/font whatever the query holds, and cachedFont still answers null and caches nothing when gstatic answers 404.
evidence: 06/11/2026, JA Boxing 1.0.11: three measurements failed FONT-1, PREV-1 and PREVIEW-PARITY on different systems each run; an instrumented preview-check showed the cache asking gstatic for /l/font%3Fkit%3D... (404) and IBM Plex Sans in status error.
fence: The address the cache fetches and what it keeps on disk, through a fetch double. Not exercised: a real Chrome and Google's css2 answer.
